versions.changelog:
- Updated instructions to call the AceToolz API using `exec`, with OS-specific examples for PowerShell (Windows) and curl (macOS/Linux).
- Clarified to adjust API body parameters dynamically based on user input before execution.
- Added error handling guidance for when the API is unreachable, suggesting users visit the AceToolz website directly.

Initial release of AceToolz UUID Generator skill.

- Generate UUIDs in bulk (v1, v4, v7) via AceToolz API.
- Supports up to 10 UUIDs per request; default is v4.
- Handles user requests for unique identifiers, UUIDs, or GUIDs.
- Provides clear guidance for usage, version selection, and error handling.
- Includes helpful presentation templates and usage policies.
